renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium work-next-move shared-world guardian card master artwork, full-bleed 3:4. Show exactly the two named guardians or canonical internal pair and no third guardian, coworker, client, human, silhouette, reflection or implied person. Preserve identities, relative size/colors, clothing, signature props, dark-purple eyes and chest Stella stars. The pair plus one shared next-step system covers 55–65% and reads at 80px. Give each guardian one independent control and keep an open handoff zone; never imply hierarchy, compulsory care, guaranteed completion, promotion or future success. Written surfaces use symbols and geometric reliefs only: no readable text, pseudo-text, names, labels, score, number, date, clock face, calendar grid, map coordinate, question mark, zodiac glyph, arrow route, logo or watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. Controls remain removable, half-set, open-ended or unlatched. Only Scorpio canonical tail-heart is allowed; no added heart. No closed ring, portal, infinity sign or deterministic route. Keep every composition distinct. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor, paper grain, plush proportions and deep-purple outlines; no readable text, no logo, no watermark.
